skill.displayName: Work Productivity Skillscan Security Workflow Helper

llm.summary: The skill does not contain hidden code or persistence, but its automatic activation rules are broad enough that it could run during unrelated work.

dimensions.detail: The workflow asks for local-friendly scripts, templates, checklists, analysis, and possible code changes; that is broadly purpose-aligned, but the activation boundary is not well contained.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install scripts, executable payloads, dependency manifests, or remote code retrieval instructions were present in the inspected artifact files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill advertises generic triggers such as security, gate, every, must, pass, before, activate, and bug fix while agents/openai.yaml sets allow_implicit_invocation to true, creating a real risk of unintended routing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No credential handling, memory writes, services, scheduled tasks, background workers, privilege escalation, or persistent agent modification instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a workflow/checklist/helper for SkillScan-style security and reliability tasks, and the actual artifacts are limited to Markdown instructions plus one YAML agent metadata file.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing because it may be selected automatically for ordinary prompts containing common words like security, every, must, or bug fix. It would be safer with implicit invocation disabled or with narrow trigger phrases tied specifically to SkillScan-style workflow assistance.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The overbroad-trigger concern is supported by artifact evidence: SKILL.md, README files, and requirement-plan.md list common single-word triggers, and agents/openai.yaml enables implicit invocation.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese localization files mix Chinese and English content, but this appears to be a documentation quality and locale clarity issue rather than hidden behavior or unsafe capability.
